old: Marrakech is the undisputed capital of Moroccan tourism, welcoming over 3.5 million international arrivals annually to its world-famous historic Medina, Gueliz modern district, and luxury resorts in the Palmeraie. With an estimated local population exceeding 1 million residents, the city's economic vitality is deeply linked to hospitality, boutique crafts, real estate, and excursion services. This extreme saturation means that over 1,500 active boutique guest houses (Riads) and hotels are actively bidding for the attention of global travelers. However, despite high internet penetration of over 85% among tourists and local businesses alike, many Marrakech-based hospitality operators remain heavily dependent on high-commission Online Travel Agencies (OTAs) such as Booking.com and Expedia. These major platforms charge anywhere from 18% to 25% commission on every transaction, severely reducing the net profit margins and direct customer relationship of local hospitality brands.
newer: Marrakech combines heritage accommodation in the Medina, urban hotels in Gueliz and resort properties around the city. Travelers compare location, room details, services, availability and booking conditions across official websites and intermediaries. For accommodation providers, the right distribution strategy depends on actual commission agreements, acquisition costs and the value of direct customer relationships.

old: The Marrakech Medina hosts over 1,500 guest houses. Standard marketing fails to stand out against OTAs, whereas specialized Riad SEO captures direct bookings.
newer: The Medina has a competitive accommodation market. A riad can differentiate itself with accurate location information, original room and experience content, and a clear direct-booking path.

old: Marrakech est incontestablement la capitale touristique du Royaume, accueillant chaque année plus de 3,5 millions de visiteurs internationaux au cœur de sa médina millénaire, du quartier moderne de Guéliz et des resorts prestigieux de la Palmeraie. Avec une population locale de plus de 1 million d'habitants, l'économie régionale dépend en grande partie de l'hôtellerie, de l'artisanat de luxe, de l'immobilier et des excursions touristiques. Cette attractivité génère une concurrence intense, illustrée par la présence de plus de 1 500 riads et maisons d'hôtes actifs luttant pour capter l'attention des voyageurs. Toutefois, malgré un taux de pénétration internet supérieur à 85 % parmi les visiteurs et les commerçants locaux, beaucoup d'établissements restent dépendants des plateformes de réservation en ligne (OTA) comme Booking.com et Expedia, qui prélèvent des commissions exorbitantes de 18 % à 25 % par séjour, réduisant significativement leur rentabilité nette.
newer: Marrakech associe les hébergements de charme de la médina, les hôtels urbains de Guéliz et les resorts autour de la ville. Les voyageurs comparent localisation, chambres, services, disponibilité et conditions de réservation sur les sites officiels et les plateformes. Le choix des canaux dépend des commissions réellement négociées, des coûts d'acquisition et de la valeur de la relation directe.

old: The digital search landscape for luxury Moroccan resorts is fiercely competitive, multiculturally diverse, and language-dependent, with potential guests from France, the UK, Germany, and the Middle East querying search engines in diverse languages (French, English, German, and Arabic). If a resort's website does not rank organically for these multilingual search terms, the property becomes virtually invisible, forcing guests to book through OTAs. Crucially, over 80% of bookings and travel research are conducted on mobile devices, meaning that slow-loading legacy websites, unoptimized PMS reservation forms, and lack of clear mobile booking interfaces lead to instant cart abandonment. Urunk engineers custom React-based hotel website platforms starting at 12,000 MAD (≈€1,100) and executes targeted SEO and PPC campaigns. Our direct booking framework bypasses OTA commission fees, boosting direct, commission-free reservations by up to +40% within 4 to 6 weeks.

We assess the current website, booking engine and acquisition costs before recommending changes. Direct booking results depend on demand, pricing, availability and the quality of the booking experience.
